note: Recast from the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. The alate, the soldier and the worker are described. Soldier measurements: 7 soldiers from 7 colonies, head length 4.65—5.50 mm, maximum head width 3.35—4.20 mm, head height without the postmentum 2.30—2.90 mm, frontal tube length 0.18—0.30 mm, left mandible length 2.05—2.45 mm, curvature 0.66—0.85 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.37—0.62 mm. The original marks the species as new (new species, type locality Manaus). Broken OCR numbers ("4.6!5-5.,5()", "2.0.'i-2.4.5") have been corrected from context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate appears indistinguishable from S. parallelus; the two share the combination of small body size, sharp anterior corners of the pronotum, small eyes, a postclypeus with only 2 short setae and dark wings. The soldier is distinguished by its relatively small size, elongate head with parallel sides, antenna of 19 segments, weakly developed thoracic spines and relatively short hind legs; compared with S. parallelus it is larger and its mandibles are stouter, more curved, with larger marginal teeth placed nearer the tip. The largest soldiers of S. longiceps may resemble the smallest individuals of S. territus, but the latter is always larger and has small marginal teeth on both mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Eyes small, less than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli relatively large; fontanelle large and round. The antennae of all available specimens are broken. Anterior corners of the pronotum angled and with a sharp point; lateral margins straight, nearly parallel in the anterior half. Wings short; the ends of the media and cubitus distinct. Head capsule with scattered short, straight setae; anterior margin of the postclypeus with 2 short setae; outer margin of the pronotum hairy; posterior margin of the abdominal tergites with a row of hairs. Head, pronotum and abdominal tergites chestnut brown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongate, the sides parallel; posterior margin of the head round. Frontal tube prominent, the opening not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal; lateral corners about right-angled; midlobe elongate, longer than the lateral lobes. Antenna 19 segments. Postmentum elongate and not constricted.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule with scattered erect setae; postclypeus with about 6 setae; fontanelle round and small. Antenna 19 segments.
